headline: Trump has treated arms sales as a bargaining chip with China
dek: Taiwan has waited months for Trump to approve a US$14B weapons/equipment package; most recent approval was the record US$11.1B package in December. Trump has resisted pressure incl.
sources: AFP (via Free Malaysia Today); context: Trump May statement, Secretary of State Marco Rubio
fault_line: Bargaining chip or betrayal? Is Trump trading Taiwan's defense for a China deal, or playing the long game? US-Taiwan deterrence math is the fault line.

sections.what_happened: Taiwan has waited months for Trump to approve a US$14B weapons/equipment package; most recent approval was the record US$11.1B package in December. Trump has resisted pressure incl. from Republican lawmakers to greenlight it; AFP notes Trump hailed his 'great friendship' with Xi Jinping last month and said in May that US arms sales to Taiwan could be a bargaining chip with China. Rubio and US officials insist American policy on Taiwan has not changed.
sections.what_verified: AFP wire; consistent with prior reporting on the $14B holdup
sections.what_disputed: Administration officials insist policy unchanged — the holdup's motive (bargaining chip vs process) is interpretation
sections.why_matters: $14B on hold: Trump said arms sales could be a bargaining chip with China. Taiwan waits; December's record $11.1B shows the scale. The split, not the bloc: Washington weighing a Beijing deal against Taipei's shield.
sections.context: Background: Taiwan — UPDATE (Oct 22): AFP analysis — what is holding up the US$14B arms sale; Trump has treated arms sales as a bargaining chip with China

totw_analysis: Our read: $14B on hold: Trump said arms sales could be a bargaining chip with China. Taiwan waits; December's record $11.1B shows the scale. The split, not the bloc: Washington weighing a Beijing deal against Taipei's shield. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Bargaining chip or betrayal? Is Trump trading Taiwan's defense for a China deal, or playing the long game? US-Taiwan deterrence math is the fault line.
